declarations.doc: The Weil–Toeplitz bound at one level.** For `N ≥ 1` and a coefficient vector `c` supported in `[1, N]`, positivity of the finite-atom Weil symbol with weights `lam` on the polar-constrained `C²` tests at the single level `a_N = log N / 2 + 1/(4(N+1))` gives `2 ∑_{2 ≤ n ≤ N} lam(n) n^{-1/2} Re ∑_m c(nm) conj(c m) ≤ (log N + C₀) ∑_m |c m|²` with the absolute constant `C₀ = log 2 + 9/2 + profileRatio/2`.

declarations.name: weil_multiplicativeToeplitz_bound
declarations.doc: The Weil–Toeplitz bound.** If the finite-atom Weil symbol with weights `lam` (and the archimedean term of `ζ`) is nonnegative on every polar-constrained `C²` test at every level, then for every `N ≥ 1` and every coefficient vector `c` supported in `[1, N]`, `2 ∑_{2 ≤ n ≤ N} lam(n) n^{-1/2} Re ∑_m c(nm) conj(c m) ≤ (log N + C₀) ∑_m |c m|²`, with an absolute constant `C₀`. Equivalently, the `N × N` multiplicative Toeplitz matrix `[lam(m/m') (m/m')^{-1/2} 1_{m' ∣ m}] + transpose` has top eigenvalue `≤ log N + C₀`. Tests: narrow polar-free bumps `g_w(x - log m)`, `w = 1/(N+1)`; their autocorrelation sees the atom `log n` only on the exact multiplicative diagonal `m = n m'`, and the archimedean symbol is bounded by `log(1/w) + O(1)` on their spectrum.

by
  obtain ⟨K, _, hK, _, _, hE, _⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW
  refine ⟨K, hK, hE, fun Q hQ => ?_⟩
  haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hQ⟩
  obtain ⟨r, _, _, hr, _, _, hRatio, _⟩ := exists_coprime_source_ratio_limit hW Q
  refine ⟨r, hr, hRatio, ?_⟩
  have he : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      weightPartialSum (fun n => ‖sourceCoeff lam n‖ ^ 2 / n) N / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 K) := by
    apply hE.congr
    intro N
    congr 1
    unfold weightPartialSum
    simp only [forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff]
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro n hn
      simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hn ⊢
      omega
    · intro n hn hn'
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_Icc] at hn hn'
        omega
      simp [hn0]
  have hfg : (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n * (coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)) =
      coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam) := by funext n; exact mul_comm _ _

      LSeries (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n * (coprimeMask Q n : ℂ)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((r : ℂ) * sourceCompletion hW 1)) := by

      rw [(sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).2, IntegerMassRigidity.zetaOf]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    rw [hfg]
    field_simp [hn]
  have hb := norm_masked_residue_sq_le_log_energy hK.le he
    (fun s hs => by rw [hfg]; exact summable_coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).1)
    (fun _ hs => mask_square_summable Q hs) (coprime_mask_square_residue Q) hR

  have hb := norm_masked_residue_sq_le_log_energy hK.le he

    (fun _ hs => mask_square_summable Q hs) (coprime_mask_square_residue Q) hR
  simpa only [norm_mul, mul_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,

/-!
# The actual source theta function is recovered from its critical trace

Right-line Mellin inversion and the actual-source contour passage give an exact
identity with the canonical measurable trace. No atomic representation, support
gap, boundary continuity, or extra coefficient estimate is assumed.
-/

open Complex Set Filter MeasureTheory Topology

noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilWorkSettledPhase

open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry WeilSpectral IntegerMassRigidity PhaseLockRigidity
  FractionalMassRigidity HamburgerStability

/-- Dirichlet coefficients of the actual producer, before any rigidity claim. -/
def sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℂ := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)

theorem sourceCoeff_LSeries {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    LSeriesSummable (sourceCoeff lam) s ∧ LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) s = zetaOf lam s :=
  LSeries_dirichletExp (lamLog_zero lam) (lamLog_one lam)
    (lseriesSummable_of_le (norm_lamLog_le lam)
      (fun _ hσ => WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull hW hσ) hs)

theorem summable_sourceCoeff {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖sourceCoeff lam (n + 1)‖ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ σ) :=
  summable_coeff_of_LSeriesSummable (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (by simpa using hσ)).1

theorem mellin_sourceCoeff {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    mellin (coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam)) (s / 2) =
      sourceRemainder hW s + betaG (sourceCompletion hW) * Gammaℝ (s - 1) := by
  have h0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; norm_num [h] at hs
  have h1 : s ≠ 1 := by intro h; simp [h] at hs
  have h1' : s - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h1
  rw [mellin_coeffTheta _ (fun σ hσ => summable_sourceCoeff hW hσ) hs,
    coeffDirichlet_eq_LSeries, (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).2,
    sourceRemainder, bigEG_eq h0 h1, sourceCompletion_eq_bigG hW hs]
  unfold bigG
  field_simp
  ring

/-- Actual theta inversion on the full canonical critical trace. The factor
`1/(4*pi)` includes the height substitution in the half-argument Mellin transform. -/
theorem coeffTheta_eq_remainderTrace {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam) r -
        betaG (sourceCompletion hW) * ((r : ℂ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℂ)) * expNegPi r) =
      (1 / (4 * Real.pi)) •
        ∫ y : ℝ, (r : ℂ) ^ (-tracePoint 0 y / 2) * remainderTrace hW y := by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := exists_decay_sourceRemainder hW
  have hmem : ∀ s ∈ verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2), 1 / 2 < s.re := by
    intro s hs
    change 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ s.re ∧ s.re ≤ 3 / 2 at hs
    linarith [hs.1]
  have hc : ContinuousOn (sourceRemainder hW) (verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2)) :=
    (differentiableOn_sourceRemainder hW).continuousOn.mono (fun s hs => hmem s hs)
  have hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sourceRemainder hW)
      {s : ℂ | 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) < s.re ∧ s.re < 3 / 2} :=
    (differentiableOn_sourceRemainder hW).mono (fun s hs => by
      change 1 / 2 < s.re
      linarith [hs.1])
  have hb : ∀ s ∈ verticalStrip (2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (3 / 2),
      ‖sourceRemainder hW s‖ ≤ C / (1 + s.im ^ 2) := by
    intro s hs
    exact hC s (hmem s hs) hs.2
  have hi := inverse_mellin_shift (θ := coeffTheta (sourceCoeff lam))
    (β := betaG (sourceCompletion hW)) (σ := 3 / 4) (by rfl)
    (continuousOn_coeffTheta _ (summable_sourceCoeff hW (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)))
    (mellinConvergent_coeffTheta _ (fun σ hσ => summable_sourceCoeff hW hσ)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) hc hd hb
    (fun s hs => mellin_sourceCoeff hW (by rw [hs]; norm_num)) hr
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun y =>
    (r : ℂ) ^ (-tracePoint 1 y / 2) * sourceRemainder hW (tracePoint 1 y)
  have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, tracePoint 1 (2 * t) = 2 * (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
    intro t
    unfold tracePoint
    push_cast
    ring
  have he : ∀ t : ℝ, -tracePoint 1 (2 * t) / 2 = -(((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
    intro t
    rw [hp]
    ring
  have hint : (∫ t : ℝ, (r : ℂ) ^ (-(((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I)) *
      sourceRemainder hW (2 * (((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I))) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ∫ y : ℝ, F y := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, F (2 * t) := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Eventually.of_forall (fun t => by dsimp [F]; rw [he, hp])
      _ = _ := by simpa using Measure.integral_comp_mul_left F 2
  rw [hint, smul_smul] at hi
  have hfactor : (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / (4 * Real.pi) := by ring
  rw [hfactor] at hi
  exact hi.trans (congrArg (fun z : ℂ => (1 / (4 * Real.pi)) • z)
    (integral_sourceRemainder_eq_boundary hW hr))

theorem tracePoint_zero_two (t : ℝ) : tracePoint 0 (2 * t) = lineS t := by
  unfold tracePoint lineS
  push_cast
  ring

private theorem tracePoint_zero_half (t : ℝ) :
    -tracePoint 0 (2 * t) / 2 = -(((1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
  rw [tracePoint_zero_two]
  unfold lineS
  ring

/-!
# No endpoint mass escapes to infinite prime valuation

The actual real valuation endpoints are absolutely summable and sum to one.
Uniform divisibility tails justify the infinite depth passage. The endpoints
are signed: neither positivity nor canonical values are claimed.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic
open WeilWorkSettledPhase

private theorem valuation_decay_lt_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ < 1 := by
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt
  have hs : 1 < Real.sqrt (p : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_one] using Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hp1
  exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hs

private theorem endpoint_geometric {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {u : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ k : ℕ, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (u k : ℂ))) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, |u k| ≤ C * (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hb⟩ := exists_forward_valuation_ratio_geometric hW hp
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun k => ?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      ‖LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)‖) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 |u k|) := by
    simpa only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hu k).norm
  exact le_of_tendsto ht (hb.mono fun s hs => hs k)

private theorem endpoint_partial_sum_bound {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {u : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hu : ∀ k : ℕ, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (u k : ℂ))) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,
      |1 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, u k| ≤ D / Real.sqrt ((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hb⟩ := exists_forward_divisibility_ratio_bound hW
  refine ⟨D, hD, fun N => ?_⟩
  have ht := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℂ))).sub
    (tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.range N) fun k _ => hu k)
  have hn : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ‖1 -
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)‖)
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 |1 - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, u k|) := by
    convert ht.norm using 1
    simp only [← Complex.ofReal_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_one, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply le_of_tendsto hn
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hb] with s hs hbs
  have ha : LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [(sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).2, IntegerMassRigidity.zetaOf]
    exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, sum_range_valuation_LSeries
    (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1,
    sub_div, div_self ha, sub_sub_cancel]
  exact hbs (p ^ N) (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)

/-- The actual endpoint sequence has total mass one and an absolute geometric
envelope. Full positivity is the only source premise. -/
theorem exists_forward_valuation_normalized_series {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∃ (u : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), 0 < u 0 ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
        LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (u k : ℂ))) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, |u k| ≤ C * (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ k) ∧
      Summable (fun k => |u k|) ∧ HasSum u 1 := by
  obtain ⟨ell, r, _, hr, _, hu⟩ := exists_forward_valuation_endpoints hW hp
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => r * valuationExponentialPolynomial ell k
  have hulim (k : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      LSeries (valuationPart p k (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (u k : ℂ)) := by
    simpa only [u, Complex.ofReal_mul] using hu k
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := endpoint_geometric hW hp hulim
  have hu0 : 0 < u 0 := by
    simpa [u, valuationExponentialPolynomial, valuationPowerPolynomial] using hr
  have hs : Summable (fun k => |u k|) :=
    ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹)
      (valuation_decay_lt_one hp)).mul_left C).of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) hbound
  refine ⟨u, C, hu0, hC, hulim, hbound, hs, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ht⟩ := endpoint_partial_sum_bound hW hp hulim
  have hpow : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => D * (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹ ^ N)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
        (by positivity : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (p : ℝ))⁻¹)
        (valuation_decay_lt_one hp)).const_mul D
  have htail : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ‖(∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, u k) - 1‖)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun N => ?_) hpow
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm, sqrt_nat_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, ← inv_pow] using ht N
